cases.task: In PocketFlow, Node(max_retries=0) and AsyncNode(max_retries=0) silently skip execution. Reject zero or negative max_retries at construction with a ValueError mentioning max_retries. Preserve behavior for positive values. Add a regression test in tests/test_max_retries_validation.py and run the repository tests.

In boltons.strutils, split_punct_ws and slugify split on ASCII punctuation and whitespace but leave Unicode punctuation attached to words. Treat Unicode punctuation (category P*) as a separator too, while preserving Unicode letters and the existing ASCII and whitespace behavior. Add regression tests to tests/test_strutils.py and run that test file.
